let packed (key : Nat) : Nat :=
  let interval := (List.range 12).foldl (fun (s : Nat × Nat) _ =>
    let mid := (s.1+s.2)/2
    if keys[mid]! = key then (mid,mid)
    else if keys[mid]! < key then (mid+1,s.2) else (s.1,mid)) (0,keys.size)
  let mid := (interval.1+interval.2)/2
  if keys[mid]! = key then endpoints[mid]! else 0
let bucket (key slots : Nat) : Finset (Fin 468) :=
  (Finset.range slots).image fun i => Fin.ofNat 468 ((packed key >>> (9*i)) &&& 511)
let dropped (a b c d : Fin 48) : Finset (Fin 468) :=
    bucket (0) (96) ∪
    bucket (2^a.val) (one a) ∪
    bucket (2^b.val) (one b) ∪
    bucket (2^c.val) (one c) ∪
    bucket (2^d.val) (one d) ∪
    bucket (2^a.val + 2^b.val) (two a b) ∪
    bucket (2^a.val + 2^c.val) (two a c) ∪
    bucket (2^a.val + 2^d.val) (two a d) ∪
    bucket (2^b.val + 2^c.val) (two b c) ∪
    bucket (2^b.val + 2^d.val) (two b d) ∪
    bucket (2^c.val + 2^d.val) (two c d) ∪
    bucket (2^a.val + 2^b.val + 2^c.val) (three a b c) ∪
    bucket (2^a.val + 2^b.val + 2^d.val) (three a b d) ∪
    bucket (2^a.val + 2^c.val + 2^d.val) (three a c d) ∪
    bucket (2^b.val + 2^c.val + 2^d.val) (three b c d) ∪
    bucket (2^a.val + 2^b.val + 2^c.val + 2^d.val) (twoBound a b c d)
∀ a b c d : Fin 48, a < b → b < c → c < d →
    262 ≤ (Finset.univ \ dropped a b c d).card
